## Improvements

- The update button at the bottom right of the usage window now shows a download arrow, so it no longer looks like Refresh.
- The selected provider tab is marked by its underline alone, and the CLI version and limit counts now line up with the headings beside them.
- Usage bars in the light theme use darker green, amber and red that stand out better against the cards.
- The usage window no longer shifts when usage finishes loading.
- Settings lines up its options, wraps long labels instead of cutting them off, and uses the same spacing on every page. Codex and Claude options now appear before Service status.
- First-run setup has clearer headings, uses the same wording as Settings and shows each provider's full usage source.

## Fixes

- Usage bars now change colour straight away when you switch theme or turn on high contrast, instead of waiting for the next refresh.
- Release notes in **Settings → About** now follow the UsageDeck theme, so they stay readable when it differs from the Windows theme.
- Screen readers now announce the Z.AI region, API key storage, API key and key buttons.

Two notification settings on each provider page have new names to match the usage window. The notification for new limit resets you can use, previously **Reset credits**, is now **Limit resets**. The notification for when a usage window resets, previously **Limit resets**, is now **Usage window resets**. Your choices are unchanged.
